info.name: Parcel Perform Analytics Tracking Events API
Create events for an existing shipment (MODELED path; operation name CONFIRMED)

items.docs: Manually creates one or more tracking events on an existing outbound or return shipment, for cases such as in-house last-mile legs not covered by a carrier feed. Confirmed via the "Create Events for an Existing Shipment" and "Create Events (v5.0)" documentation page titles; exact path and payload are modeled on the documented event object (status, location, timestamp).
